note:
Private exclusion manifest for training + evaluation exports. Machine-readable list of content hashes that MUST NOT appear in generated training sets or private ship evaluation datasets.

The canonical source for exclusions is `public.review_exclusions` in the production Supabase project. This file is the CI-visible mirror; admins export from that table when items are retired (public_reviewed, reported_quarantine, consent_withdrawn, account_deleted, admin_quarantine).

The hash algorithm mirrors the R2 importer: SHA-256 of `${direction}|${normalizedSource}|${normalizedTarget}` where `normalizedX` collapses whitespace to a single space and trims.

CI check: `node scripts/check_review_exclusions.mjs`.
